title: 美国美国最高法院推翻政党支出上限共和党重大胜利竞选资金规则再松动
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: We have another decision coming from the Supreme Court this morning.
segments.zh: 今早最高法院又有一项裁决。

segments.en: Avoiding political party spending caps, this is a win for the GOP, something that they have been pushing.
segments.zh: 取消政党支出上限，对共和党而言是胜利，也是他们一直推动的。

segments.en: We're still waiting for a birthright case. Let's get the details now with Tyler Kendall, our Washington correspondent who's outside the Supreme Court.
segments.zh: 我们还在等出生公民权案。请华盛顿记者泰勒·肯德尔在最高法院外带来详情。

segments.en: So the Supreme Court is avoiding political party spending caps.
segments.zh: 最高法院取消了政党支出上限。

segments.en: This is a win for Republicans and it's really considered to be monumental for campaign finances.
segments.zh: 这对共和党是胜利，被认为对竞选财务具有里程碑意义。

segments.en: We head into November in the midterm elections. I can quite literally see the Capitol building behind me because we know that the balance of control of Congress is hanging in the balance on this.
segments.zh: 我们即将进入11月中期选举。我身后就是国会大厦，因为国会控制权平衡悬而未决。

segments.en: Now, this case was the National Republican Sanitorial Committee, the NRSC, versus the FEC, the Federal Election Commission, and a fun fact about this.
segments.zh: 本案是全国共和党参议院委员会诉联邦选举委员会，有个趣闻。

segments.en: This case was actually first brought in federal court in Ohio, which means that Vice President J.D. Vance is actually a plaintiff on this case because he brought it when he was then candidate
segments.zh: 此案最初在俄亥俄州联邦法院提起，副总统万斯是原告之一，当时他还是候选人。

segments.en: J.D. Vance, running for Senate in 2022, Republicans here were challenging a federal law that limits the amount of money political parties can spend in coordination with the candidate
segments.zh: 2022年万斯竞选参议员时，共和党挑战一项限制政党与候选人协调支出的联邦法律。

segments.en: in office. This is known as a coordinated expenditure limit.
segments.zh: 在任期间。这被称为协调支出上限。

segments.en: Think of it as a cap that they're able to coordinate between the two and Republicans argue that putting that cap on it violates the First Amendment because it doesn't allow the
segments.zh: 可以把它看作一个上限，双方可以协调，但共和党人认为设置这个上限违反了第一修正案，因为它不允许

segments.en: two sides to coordinate on political messaging in TV ads.
segments.zh: 双方在电视广告中协调政治信息。
